On his telling, shorts were layered across the portfolio early in the week, margin calls followed, and Citadel then bought the whole book in a block trade, after which the shorts came off. He points to the fund's top ten positions all rallying between 19% and 29% that day as evidence, and questions whether Citadel's rate-hike narrative earlier in the week was self-serving. He presents this as his own reading, not established fact.
